title: Table Format Painter (Tables)

scenarios.title: Table Format Painter applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Table Format Painter (BtnTableFormatPainter) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnTableFormatPainter deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the Table Format Painter paint-down invoked from source cell (1,1) of a fixture 3x3 table copies the source's red fill and 17 pt font into the cells (2,1) and (3,1), leaves every other cell's fill and font untouched, keeps all texts and table dimensions, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the Table Format Painter paint-down invoked from source cell (1,1) of a fixture 3x3 table copies the source's red fill and 17 pt font into the cells (2,1) and (3,1), leaves every other cell's fill and font untouched, keeps all texts and table dimensions, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
